subject.title: feat: add autoreview model and speed defaults

question: Should AutoReview expose arbitrary Codex `-c` passthrough plus `--codex-speed`, and should Cursor require explicit trusted-workspace opt-in for every Cursor run?
rationale: This changes provider routing, cost/service-tier semantics, and Cursor upgrade behavior in a public shared helper, while VISION.md requires exact runtime proof for provider-specific tiers or modes.

options.title: Require Proof And Accept Bounded Contract
options.body: Ask for redacted live output proving the custom Codex model and speed path on this head, then merge only if maintainers accept the documented opt-in boundary.

options.title: Narrow The Public Surface
options.body: Limit the PR to `--codex-speed` or specific documented Codex keys and keep arbitrary config passthrough or Cursor trust changes for separate discussion.

options.title: Pause Provider-Specific Defaults
options.body: Pause or close this PR if shared AutoReview should keep provider-specific tier/config controls outside this repository for now.

recommendation.title: Require Proof And Accept Bounded Contract
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live output proving the custom Codex model and speed path on this head, then merge only if maintainers accept the documented opt-in boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Coy Geek has recent merged ownership of the model/default/provider option surface and authored the earlier broad fast-profile request that frames this decision.
